what: The plan for the mock sweep's node/repositories slice (docs/plan/quests/mock-node-repositories-PLAN.md) had no test-support file in its file table. It planned L3 in the file that already held the helpers (repoSnapshot, reader, personName, document). Plan correction 1 then moved L3 into a new plain OpenRepository.test.ts, because the old file had been renamed to OpenRepository.composed.integration.test.ts. That left the new file a copy of those helpers. The review of 2026-11-18 found the copies. The fix round added next/packages/libfabrika/src/node/repositories/OpenRepository.test-support.ts, holding one shared copy that both files import. The coordinator approved the new file under the lead's standing ruling for a new file in the slice's own folder that no other owner holds.
cause: The plan's file table was written for L3 in place. The move of L3 to a new file was a correction made at the tests step, and nothing re-read the file table for what the move now needed.
fix: One test-support file in the folder, imported by both test files; no layer-rules.json row was needed, and no law body changed.
test: On the next sweep slice, when a plan correction moves a law to a new file, check at once whether the helpers the law uses must move with it.
